subject: You don’t need to know a sailor or own a sailboat to start sailing in Boston
posts: Sailing the Charles isn't just for the elite, but your wallet might disagree. You don’t need to know a sailor or own a sailboat to start sailing in Boston. Evidence: Accessible hobby, high entry cost, skill-based barrier. #Boston #Sailing
